fadescreen.options.enabled.tooltip: Fade screens in and out with an alpha transition instead of a black overlay.
fadescreen.options.duration.tooltip: Length of the cross-fade in milliseconds. 0 disables the animation.
fadescreen.options.low_res.tooltip: Render the offscreen fade copy at GUI-scaled resolution. Saves VRAM on 4K displays, but text is slightly softer while fading.
